questions.prompt: What relationship types should be supported in the Research Map?
questions.description: The roadmap mentions: supporting papers, contradictory papers, similar methodologies, different datasets, different findings.
questions.recommendedAnswer: supporting, contradicting, similar_methodology, different_dataset, different_findings, extends

questions.prompt: How should paper relationships be created?
questions.description: The POST /api/papers/{id}/relationships endpoint already exists. Should relationships be created manually by users, or should the system auto-detect them from citations/abstracts?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Manual creation only for MVP. Auto-detection can be added later.

questions.prompt: What frontend visualization style for the Research Map?
questions.description: How should related papers be displayed on the result page?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Card-based list grouped by relationship type, matching existing UI patterns (result-page.jsx).

questions.prompt: Where should the Research Map appear in the UI?
questions.recommendedAnswer: New tab/section on the result page, accessible via a button in the action bar.

questions.prompt: What metadata should be shown for each related paper?
questions.recommendedAnswer: Title, relationship type, evidence text, link to view. Status if available.
